faq.howToOrder: How do I order a cleaning service?
faq.howToOrderAnswer: Ordering is very simple. You can contact us by phone at +420 773 601 737, send an email to info@greenclean.cz or fill out the contact form on our website. We will respond with a price quote within 24 hours.
faq.serviceScope: What is the scope of your services?
faq.serviceScopeAnswer: We offer comprehensive cleaning services including home cleaning, office and commercial cleaning, Airbnb cleaning, furniture cleaning, post-renovation cleaning, development projects and apartment buildings. We customize each service to the individual needs of the client.
faq.priceCalculation: How is the cleaning price calculated?
faq.priceCalculationAnswer: The price is determined based on the size of the space (m²) and the type of service. We offer transparent pricing without hidden fees. For an accurate price, contact us with details about your space.
faq.ecoProducts: Do you use eco-friendly cleaning products?
faq.ecoProductsAnswer: Yes, we emphasize ecology. We use certified eco-friendly cleaning products that are gentle on the environment and your health.

faq.needToBePresentAnswer: It is not necessary. You can provide us with access to the spaces and we will perform the cleaning according to the agreed plan. Of course, you can be present if you prefer.

faq.description: Answers to the most common questions about apartment and house cleaning
faq.q1: How often would you recommend regular cleaning?
faq.a1: For a regular household, we recommend cleaning 1x per week or 2x per month. It depends on apartment size, number of residents and your preferences. We'll be happy to help you find the ideal frequency.
faq.q2: Do I need to be home during cleaning?
faq.a2: No, we offer key service. After signing a contract, we can clean even without your presence. We have liability insurance and all our workers are verified.
faq.q3: Do you provide your own cleaning supplies?
faq.a3: Yes, we bring our own eco-friendly cleaning supplies and professional equipment. However, we can also use your products if you prefer or have special requirements.
faq.q4: Do you clean on weekends too?
faq.a4: Yes, we offer cleaning 7 days a week including Saturdays and Sundays to accommodate your schedule. Weekend appointments are very popular, so we recommend booking in advance.
faq.q5: What if I need to change the appointment?
faq.a5: Just let us know at least 24 hours in advance and we'll arrange an alternative appointment without any fees. We understand that life brings unexpected situations.
faq.q6: Do you also offer deep cleaning?
faq.a6: Yes, we also perform extensive deep cleaning including window washing, stove cleaning, refrigerator, tiles and other more demanding work. We recommend deep cleaning 2-4x per year.
